answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume and only 14 days before expiry, protecting incumbent continuity is the lowest delivery-risk path. Verify the prior price/payment benchmark and multi-year volume-discount records, then use them to negotiate an incumbent renewal that targets the mandated spend reduction without changing service scope or introducing migration risk. The 18% target may not be fully achievable through terms alone, so that gap remains explicit rather than assuming a switch is safe.
